tools.name: counterparty_due_diligence
tools.description: Screen a new counterparty (person or company) in one call before onboarding, contracting or paying it. Checks sanctions (OFAC, EU, UK; UN via EU/UK), the US Consolidated Screening List, PEP (Wikidata) and registries (GLEIF, Norway). Returns no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_dete
